notes.title: Flying Tank 2.0
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of [b]Flying Tank 2.0[/b]! The game has been available in Early Access for over a year as part of the 1.x series. We’re incredibly grateful for your patience and feedback, which have helped us improve the game significantly.

As part of the 2.0 release on Steam, we’re introducing four new tanks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/010f483abd4b80237b4bee82354513764da1ca3d.png[/img]

[b]Tengri Vengador[/b] - Use the Biomass Harvester ability to collect Biomass blobs simply by shooting at them! Extract more Biomass from human tissue and even repair some bodywork through vehicular manslaughter.

[b]Sigma Prototype[/b] - Enjoy the longest lasting Overdrive, Shield, Invulnerability and Hyper Focus with its Super Power ability. The duration of all collectible power-ups is doubled!

[b]Wardozer[/b] - Smash into your enemies with impunity. Combine your unique Crusher power with the Combat Bumper upgrade and repair damage by running down chains of smaller enemies.

[b]Radiant[/b] - Extra Special in more than just its name - every Special you choose will be boosted with an extra charge or duration! Use it to create the most powerful Unmaker Omega or any other Special-focused build.

Another noteworthy feature is the new [b]Coop UI[/b], designed to provide a more streamlined local multiplayer experience. While game controllers remain the preferred way to enjoy multiplayer, we’ve also added support for a [b]split keyboard[/b] setup. This allows two players to use a single keyboard during Remote Play Together sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/af8756b240dfe9e82899a192ec9e7d9bc78d53db.png[/img]

Additionally, the graphics have been upgraded to feature sharper visuals and smoother animations. We’ve also added support for [b]variable refresh rates[/b] on gaming monitors with FreeSync and G-SYNC, enhancing frame pacing in fullscreen mode for a smoother gaming experience.

We're also releasing a [b]Flying Tank Demo[/b], which includes the first 8 missions. If you decide to purchase the full game, your progress from the demo will carry over.

Thank you!

notes.title: Unique Tank Powers and Mastery
notes.notes:
[h3]Unique Powers[/h3]
Experiment with various play styles for each Tank and create loadouts with equipment customized to your tank's [b]Unique Power[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/f7db492df19255d641c58f6ea0d33be1704dbee4.png[/img]
[h3]Mastery Rewards[/h3]
Grind with purpose using the new [b]Mastery[/b] system; replay missions to fill the Mastery Wreath and earn rewards with [b]extra Biomass or Tanks[/b]. Even a failed mission adds percentages to the Mastery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/64e22eb928a33f7d5e4d3939ceed60fe2e99ea41.png[/img]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
You can now fully enjoy the game story with [b]localization[/b] available in German, French, Spanish (LatAm), and Czech languages.

[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
A new pumped up track has been added to the gameplay loop: [b]Interstellar by Kubatko[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/fec5686a0e5c4da801abb8624bf9be6902c87c73.png[/img] Have you unraveled the mystery of the elusive [b]Alien Interface[/b] yet?

notes.title: Flying Tank's First Price Increase Is Coming
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

We always knew the price would increase as we release new chapters.

If you are reading this before [b]October 2, 2023[/b], then you still have time to get the game at [b]15% off[/b] the launch price during Steam [b]SHMUP Fest[/b] between September 25 - October 2, which will be about as cheap as the game will be for quite a while.

After that the game will go [b]from $4.99 to $7.99 USD[/b], and all other currencies will increase as well in a similar proportion.

If you own it and have a friend with it on their wishlist, it might be a good time to let them know!

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Chapter Two is Live
notes.notes:
Story continues with [b]8 new Missions[/b], 5 new Tanks, 4 new Weapons and Upgrades.

Visit the last great city on earth - Newark - Capital of the World; enter the Deep Space Network Complex, a rusting scrapyard of the long-defunct NASA space program; and soar into the storm clouds of the most difficult mission yet - [b]Retribution[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/c831c232c11030d421ca201a50a7801713019fc4.png[/img]

A whole new technologically advanced enemy faction enters the fray - [b]Coexistential Government[/b]! Face Government Drones, APCs, Assault Racers, and a powerful fleet of Fighters, Gunships, Beam Casters, Battlecruisers, and Destroyers. Aliens are joined by the utterly disgusting Spiderticks and the relentless Splitters. Scavengers are not finished either, expect the second coming of a Scavenger boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44404121/afb1f9013160fd66377dec72244fe5f973594f04.png[/img]

[h3]EASY MODE[/h3]

For casual players, we've introduced a new difficulty option: EASY MODE.

EASY MODE eliminates recovery time and equipment loss after mission failure. Additionally, in EASY MODE, enemies won't reach their highest aggression state, resulting in a less challenging experience. Please note that [b]online scores and achievements[/b] are disabled in EASY MODE.
